jobs.title: Project Sales Manager - Basement Parking & Safety Products
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

We are looking for an experienced Project Sales \& Execution Manager for our Basement Parking \& Road Safety Products division.

The candidate will be responsible for generating new business from builders, developers, contractors and infrastructure companies, as well as supervising project execution and installations at customer sites.

**Key Responsibilities**

Business Development \& Sales

\* Develop new business with builders, real estate developers, civil contractors, infrastructure companies and consultants.

\* Identify upcoming construction and basement parking projects.

\* Generate enquiries and convert them into orders.

\* Develop relationships with builders, project heads, consultants, architects, PMC companies and contractors.

\* Conduct regular customer and project\-site visits.

\* Prepare quotations and commercial proposals and follow up until order closure.

\* Maintain a strong pipeline of upcoming projects.

\* Achieve monthly and annual sales targets.

\* Develop repeat business from existing customers.

**Project Execution**

\* Supervise supply and installation activities at project sites.

\* Coordinate with customers, site engineers, contractors and installation teams.

\* Ensure installation is carried out according to specifications and agreed timelines.

\* Plan manpower and material requirements for projects.

\* Monitor project progress and ensure timely completion.

\* Resolve site\-level issues and customer complaints.

\* Coordinate with internal teams for material dispatch and installation schedules.

\* Prepare regular project progress reports for management.

\* Ensure proper quality and workmanship at all sites.

**Candidate Requirements**

\* 5\-10 years of experience in construction sales, building materials, infrastructure products, road safety products, parking solutions or related industries.

\* Experience dealing with builders, developers, contractors and project consultants is highly preferred.

\* Candidates with an existing network among builders, contractors and infrastructure companies will have an advantage.

\* Should have experience in both B2B sales and project/site execution.

\* Strong communication, negotiation and follow\-up skills.

\* Should be willing to travel extensively to customer and project sites.

\* Should be capable of independently handling projects from lead generation order conversion execution completion.

\* Civil Engineering/Diploma or relevant technical qualification will be preferred.

\* Valid driving licence preferred

**Ideal Candidate**

We are looking for someone who is commercially aggressive, technically capable and comfortable working at project sites.

The ideal candidate should be able to bring new projects, convert orders and independently supervise their execution.

**Essential:**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* MBA/PGDM in Sales \& Marketing / Business Management will be an added advantage.

**5\. REQUIRED EXPERIENCE**

* **8–12 years of relevant experience** in Sales, Marketing, Commercial Sales or Business Development.

jobs.description:
Job Description – Google Ads Specialist

**Company:** Dazzle Sports Wear  
**Department:** Digital Marketing  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Location:** Dulapally,Hyderabad, Telangana  
**Experience:** 2–4 Years

About the Role

We are looking for a **Google Ads Specialist** who can manage, optimize, and scale paid advertising campaigns for our growing e\-commerce business.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on experience with **Google Ads, Performance Max, Shopping Ads, Search Ads, Google Merchant Center, GA4, conversion tracking, and e\-commerce performance marketing**.

The primary responsibility will be to generate **profitable sales, improve ROAS, reduce CPA, and continuously optimize campaigns based on data and customer behavior.**

Key ResponsibilitiesGoogle Ads Campaign Management

* Plan, create, launch, and manage Google Ads campaigns for e\-commerce.
* Manage **Performance Max, Shopping, Search, Display, and YouTube campaigns**.
* Build appropriate campaign and product\-group structures based on product categories.
* Manage campaign budgets and allocate spend toward high\-performing products and audiences.
* Monitor daily performance and take corrective actions when required.

Performance Optimization

* Optimize campaigns to improve **ROAS, CPA, conversion rate, revenue, and profitability**.
* Analyze campaign performance at campaign, asset group, product, audience, device, location, and search\-term levels.
* Identify underperforming products, keywords, creatives, and audiences.
* Conduct A/B testing of ad copy, assets, landing pages, bidding strategies, and campaign structures.
* Scale profitable campaigns while controlling unnecessary ad spend.

Google Merchant Center

* Manage and optimize **Google Merchant Center**.
* Monitor product feed health, product disapprovals, price/availability issues, and policy\-related problems.
* Optimize product titles, descriptions, attributes, images, and product categorization for Shopping performance.
* Coordinate with the website/technical team to resolve feed and Merchant Center issues.

Tracking \& Analytics

* Set up and monitor **Google Ads conversion tracking**.
* Work with **GA4, Google Tag Manager, and Google Ads** to ensure accurate purchase and revenue tracking.
* Validate conversion data and identify tracking discrepancies.
* Analyze customer journeys and identify opportunities to improve conversion performance.
* Prepare regular performance reports with actionable insights.

Keyword \& Competitor Research

* Conduct keyword research for products and categories.
* Identify high\-intent commercial and transactional keywords.
* Monitor search terms and add negative keywords where required.
* Analyze competitor advertising strategies and identify opportunities.

Key Performance Metrics

The candidate will be responsible for monitoring and improving:

* **ROAS**
* **CPA / Cost per Purchase**
* **Conversion Rate**
* **Revenue**
* **Ad Spend**
* **Average Order Value (AOV)**
* **Cost per Conversion**
* **CTR**
* **CPC**
* **Impression Share**
* **Shopping / PMax product performance**

Required Skills

* Strong hands\-on experience with **Google Ads**
* Performance Max campaign expertise
* Google Shopping campaign experience
* Google Merchant Center knowledge
* Search campaign management
* GA4 knowledge
* Google Tag Manager knowledge
* Conversion tracking and troubleshooting
* Keyword research and search\-term analysis
* Google Ads reporting and data analysis
* Strong understanding of e\-commerce funnels
* Ability to work with large product catalogs
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills

Preferred Experience

Experience with **fashion, apparel, sportswear, D2C, Shopify, or other e\-commerce businesses** will be an advantage.

Experience managing campaigns with significant monthly advertising budgets and a proven track record of improving **ROAS and online sales** is preferred.

What We Expect

* Data\-driven decision making
* Strong understanding of Google Ads bidding strategies
* Ability to independently manage campaigns from setup to optimization
* Ability to identify problems rather than simply report them
* Strong attention to conversion tracking and data accuracy
* Ability to work closely with SEO, creative, website, and e\-commerce teams
* Focus on **sales and profitability rather than only traffic or clicks**

jobs.title: Product Manager, Advanced Enterprise Data Platform
jobs.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end\-to\-end, 0 to 1, etc).


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Master's degree in a technology or business related field.
* Experience working in data, enterprise, platform or infrastructure.
* Experience working in a geographically distributed team with cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Experience managing complex data platforms, drafting detailed Product Requirements Documents (PRDs), and executing long\-term product roadmaps.
* Deep knowledge of AI/ML foundations, RAG, and semantic modeling.
* Ability to define platform success metrics from user feedback while ensuring strict data privacy and security compliance.


**About The Job**
 At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
   

  

 In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.
   

  

 One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.
   

  

 As a Product Manager for the Enterprise Data Platform (EDP), you will drive the direction to transform Google’s data landscape into an AI\-ready ecosystem. You will lead the development of advanced semantic and reasoning capabilities, such as hybrid search, enterprise knowledge graphs, and GraphRAG, to unify our currently fragmented data space. By bridging structured and unstructured sources, you will enable autonomous agents to execute high\-stakes business workflows with deterministic accuracy and safety. You will collaborate across cross\-functional domains to drive product\-market fit, ensuring our platform provides the secure, governed, and certified data foundation required to power Google’s next generation of agentic intelligence.
   

  

 At Corp Eng, we build world\-leading business solutions that scale a more helpful Google for everyone. As Google’s IT organization, we provide end\-to\-end solutions for organizations across Google. We deliver the right tools, platforms, and experiences for all Googlers as they create more helpful products and services for everyone. In the simplest terms, we are Google for Googlers.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive the platform's goal by balancing immediate operational needs with a clear roadmap for an AI\-ready, unified enterprise data ecosystem.
* Generate and define detailed product requirements and feature specifications to solve complex data fragmentation and governance challenges.
* Partner with business units to align dependencies and ensure the platform meets wide\-ranging enterprise requirements.
* Engage directly with domain owners to lead platform adoption, optimize common capabilities, and achieve product\-market fit.
* Define satisfaction metrics through user feedback while navigating ambiguity to maintain enterprise standards and high\-impact delivery.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively.

As that portfolio grows, we need a Technical Product Manager who can connect business needs to technical delivery — ensuring the products we build are not only strategically aligned, but also practical, measurable, and well\-adopted.

**Summary**
**Position Summary**
 Applied AI Senior Product Specialist
   

  

 An Applied AI Senior Product Specialist is a mid\-level individual contributor responsible for ensuring a product’s value and viability within a product line. This role involves leading empowered, cross\-function al product teams to solve customer problems that align with business needs. Being a mid\-level product management role, you will have the opportunity to own products of lesser complexity that drive business value. The Applied AI Senior Product Specialist, like any of our product managers, is accountable for the product’s success, from vision to execution, and collaborates closely with various functions and stakeholders to deliver valuable, viable, usable, and feasible solutions. This role harnesses AI and agentic tools to compress the concept\-to\-cas h learning loop—automatin g analysis, prototyping, and compliance detail\-work so the team can focus on the human judgment AI cannot replace: product sense\-making.
   

  

 The Applied AI Senior Product Specialist plays a crucial role in ensuring the success of our less complex yet valuable products by balancing customer needs with business objectives. This role requires a blend of strategic vision, analytical skills, and collaborative teamwork to deliver valuable, viable, usable, and feasible solutions. It demands some experience in the modern product management craft and a drive for continuous improvement—am plified by the fluent, responsible use of AI to learn faster and earn faster.
   

  

 Work you’ll do
   

  

* Product Accountability
* Responsible and accountable for the product's value and viability showcasing a measurable Return on Investments (ROI)
* Drive strategy\-align ed solutions to achieve product value objectives.

* Measure KPIs and analyze outcomes to inform future strategies.
* Leverage AI to harvest outcome evidence early and often, lowering total cost of ownership (TCO).

* Co\-create in collaboration with business stakeholders, engineering, experience, and delivery.

* Continuous Improvement
* Remove obstacles for the team and ensure smooth flow of continuous value achievement.
* Promote and drive rapid, emergent, and ongoing learning and adaptation to meet objectives.

* Spread knowledge and best practices within the product vertical community.

* Amplify learning: use AI agents to synthesize research and validate ideas before they enter the backlog—compre ssing lead time by accelerating the data crunching, ensuring the human connection.
* Amplify focus: act as Editor\-in\-Chie f—using AI to rigorously test assumptions and retire ideas that do not genuinely serve the user’s workflow in a way that works for the business.
* Amplify experimentatio n: use AI to build early, functional, disposable prototypes that validate the architecture and the solution, playing a key role in the Agentic Secure Software Development Life Cycle that paves a clear path for engineering to productionize.

* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

 Deloitte Product Engineering (PxE) is developing advanced, agentic AI\-enabled solutions that are redefining the future of work across our organization and for global clients. We are committed to bringing together outstanding product, engineering, and design talent to lead this t ransformation.

 Required:

jobs.title: Staff Inbound Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
 It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
   

  

 Join us to put AI to work for people.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role summary:**
 This is an inbound technical product manager role. You'll own the design and delivery of ServiceNow's ITSM and ITOM products — Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge, Service Catalog, Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, and CMDB — in a live production environment, measure how they actually perform, and use that evidence to influence what the products should become.
   

  

 Three things make this role distinct from a standard implementation specialist:
   

  

* You own the outcome, not the deployment. Go\-live is the midpoint. You instrument the solution, track adoption and performance in production, and iterate when the data says the design didn't land.
* You're the voice of the customer, from inside. You'll partner directly with ServiceNow Product Management for ITSM and ITOM — evaluating new and pre\-GA capability under real operational load, documenting gaps with evidence, and tracking them to closure.
* You can carry the story upward. You'll represent this work in executive forums, translating implementation detail into the impact language leadership needs to make decisions.


 You'll spend part of your week across the table from business stakeholders shaping requirements, part with engineering getting it built, and part with Product shaping the roadmap. If you only want one of those three, this isn't the role.
   

  

**What You Get To Do**
**Shape the solution**
* Run discovery sessions with business stakeholders and process owners to understand current\-state pain, process gaps, and desired outcomes
* Translate business requirements into a recommended ServiceNow solution design, and pitch it credibly — including where out\-of\-box beats customization and where scope should be cut
* Drive alignment across competing stakeholders, secure sign\-off on scope and design decisions, and document the agreed solution


**Deliver it with engineering**
* Translate approved designs into deployable epics and stories with clear acceptance criteria, dependencies, and definition of done — well\-formed enough that engineering can build without guessing
* Walk engineering through design intent, defend the "why" behind decisions, and work through technical trade\-offs and constraints collaboratively as build progresses
* Act as the single point of translation between engineering and the business. When engineering needs clarification, you go get it — you own the round trip back to the business stakeholder rather than pulling engineers into stakeholder meetings to ask directly
* Manage scope, sequencing, and backlog priority with engineering through the build, and unblock decisions rather than escalating them
* Own UAT coordination, go\-live readiness, and hypercare
* Advise on platform best practices, upgrade\-safe design, and technical debt avoidance


**Measure it**
* Instrument every implementation for measurability from day one — define success metrics and baselines before build starts, not after go\-live
* Personally build and maintain the reports and dashboards that show whether the solution is actually delivering: adoption, deflection, cycle time, process compliance, data quality, and where the process is leaking
* Use the data to drive iteration — surface underperformance to stakeholders proactively, recommend fixes, and close the loop rather than declaring victory at deployment


**Accelerate it**
* Use AI tooling to compress delivery cycles — apply general\-purpose AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to accelerate requirements synthesis, data analysis, rapid prototyping of solution concepts for stakeholder validation, test case generation, and documentation — and bring a point of view on where AI genuinely speeds delivery versus where it adds noise


**Influence the product**
* Represent your work in executive forums like monthly product reviews: what you delivered, why that approach, and what measurable impact it created. Distill technical detail into outcome language a VP can act on
* Partner with ServiceNow Product Management for ITSM and ITOM — build durable working relationships with the teams building these products, evaluate new and pre\-GA capabilities in a real production environment, and provide grounded, constructive feedback based on actual adoption experience
* Own the product gap loop — document capability gaps that block or slow adoption, translate them into clear, evidence\-backed asks with business impact attached, and track them through to closure with Product and Engineering rather than logging them and moving on


**Qualifications**
**To be successful in this role you have:**
* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision\-making, or problem\-solving. This may include using AI\-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI\-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 8\+ years delivering ServiceNow solutions, with at least 3 full lifecycle ITSM and ITOM deployments owned end to end
* Prior product management experience, formal or informal
* Experience operating in an internal IT / Customer Zero model, deploying capability before general availability
* Exposure to enterprise CMDB remediation at scale
* Experience with AI\-driv…

jobs.description:
We have an exciting opportunity to join our team within Macquarie Asset Management, a global asset manager trusted by institutions, pension funds, governments, and individuals to manage billions in assets globally. We provide specialist investment expertise across a broad range of asset classes, including fixed income, equities, private markets, infrastructure, real estate, and sustainable investments.

You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future.
   

  

**What role will you play?**
 In this role, you will lead the strategy, development, and delivery of a strategic reporting and valuations platform for Real Assets and Real Estate, driving business process transformation and enabling technology. You will define and execute the product strategy, collaborate with stakeholders across investment and fund management functions, and ensure solutions deliver measurable business value while meeting regulatory and security requirements. Leading a high\-performing team, you will champion Agile delivery, AI and automation, and effective change management to drive adoption and successful business outcomes.
   

  

**What You Offer**
* 16\+ years’ experience in product management and program delivery within financial services, asset management, or another data\-intensive industry, with a strong track record of leading complex transformation initiatives.
* Deep expertise in middle office operations, portfolio reporting, valuations, and data transformation, with the ability to translate business needs into clear product strategies, roadmaps, and delivery plans.
* Proven experience defining product vision, managing backlogs, and writing epics and user stories in close partnership with engineering, data, and architecture teams.
* Strong understanding of data platforms, reporting solutions, portfolio management systems, and business process transformation, with the ability to bridge business and technology stakeholders effectively.
* Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships, influence senior leaders, and clearly communicate complex concepts to diverse audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional, global teams, drive alignment, manage competing priorities, and deliver outcomes in fast\-paced and ambiguous environments.
* A proactive, continuous improvement mindset, with experience championing Agile delivery, driving change adoption, and leveraging digital, AI, and automation capabilities to enhance business outcomes.


 We love hearing from anyone inspired to build a better future with us, if you're excited about the role or working at Macquarie we encourage you to apply.
   

  

**What We Offer**
**Benefits**
 At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that’s rewarding in all the ways that matter most to you. Macquarie employees can access a wide range of benefits which, depending on eligibility criteria, include:
   

  

* 1 wellbeing leave day per year
* 26 weeks’ paid maternity leave or 20 weeks’ paid parental leave for primary caregivers along with 12 days of paid transition leave upon return to work and 6 weeks’ paid leave for secondary caregivers
* Company\-subsidised childcare services
* 2 days of paid volunteer leave and donation matching
* Benefits to support your physical, mental and financial wellbeing including comprehensive medical and life insurance cover, the option to join parental medical insurance plan and virtual medical consultations extended to family members
* Access to our Employee Assistance Program, a robust behavioural health network with counselling and coaching services
* Access to a wide range of learning and development opportunities, including reimbursement for professional membership or subscription
* Hybrid and flexible working arrangements, dependent on role
* Reimbursement for work from home equipment


**About Macquarie Asset Management**
 Macquarie Asset Management is a leading global asset manager, trusted by institutions, individuals and communities to responsibly manage $A720 billion in assets. MAM provides clients with a diverse range of investment solutions that seek to deliver superior risk\-adjusted returns.

jobs.description:
Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively.

**What you will do**
--------------------


You will join our Software Excellence department, working at the intersection of operational analytics, incident management, and product quality. You will take ownership of analytical deliverables, contribute to data model development, and play an active role in shaping how operational intelligence is built and consumed.

### **Build and maintain analytical data models**

* Design and maintain dimensional models and semantic layers in Power BI or equivalent — including star schema structures, calculated measures, hierarchies, and row\-level security — following established architectural standards.
* Apply appropriate modelling patterns such as SCD and medallion layer conventions, and actively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks including query folding, cardinality issues, and incremental refresh configuration.
* Contribute to the definition and documentation of metrics and KPIs — specifying calculation logic, grain, and refresh cadence — and ensure consistent application across dashboards and reports.
* Work within the analytical architecture standards set by the Lead Data Analyst, and proactively flag opportunities to improve model quality, reusability, and maintainability.

### **Investigate operational signals and analyse data**

* Investigate operational and customer\-facing signals across multiple products and systems — combining data from telemetry, crash logs, support records, incident data, and observability platforms to surface patterns and root causes.

* Apply statistical techniques to detect anomalies, identify trends, and quantify product quality signals — including time\-series analysis, cohort analysis, and threshold\-based alerting.

### **Collaborate across functions**

* Work closely with Incident Management, Support, SRE Engineers, Software Development, and Data Engineering stakeholders to understand data needs and deliver relevant, trustworthy analytical outputs.
* Communicate findings clearly and adapt your message to different audiences — from engineers and domain experts to project managers and business stakeholders.

* Proven track record of delivering analytical solutions across multiple data sources in a software\-driven environment.
* Experience working with defined metrics frameworks and contributing to their documentation and improvement.

### **Technical skills**

* Strong proficiency in SQL — including window functions, CTEs, query optimisation, and working with large datasets.
* Proficiency in Python for analytical work — including pandas, NumPy, and visualisation libraries.

* Proficiency in KQL for querying operational and telemetry data in Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights.
* Experience working with Databricks or equivalent platforms as an analytical consumer — querying Delta tables and using notebooks for exploratory work.
* Familiarity with Azure data services relevant to analytical consumption — including Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Monitor, and Log Analytics.

**JLL Technologies**
**Product Manager, Smart Building Platform**
**Team**
 Workplace Management Product
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 JLL manages real estate for some of the world’s largest organizations. Behind the scenes, a small product team is rebuilding how that work happens — replacing disconnected building systems, reactive maintenance cycles, and siloed sensor data with unified operational intelligence and AI\-powered workflows.
   

  

 This role sits at the center of that shift. As PM for the Smart Building Platform, you will own a next\-generation product that unifies building systems, IoT data streams, and operational analytics to help clients achieve breakthrough gains in efficiency, sustainability, and occupant experience — across portfolios that span millions of square feet.
   

  

 A defining part of this role is knowing how to operate at the edge of first\- and third\-party product boundaries: building systems, IoT protocols, and CMMS integrations are rarely clean. You will be the person who defines where JLL’s platform ends and where a vendor’s capability begins — and then builds the right thing in the right place.
   

  

**What makes this role unusual:**
 You are PM for the Smart Building Platform — which means real ownership, not a sub\-feature. You will set the roadmap, write the requirements, and be accountable for outcomes.
   

  

 The AI work here is live, not aspirational. Agentic workflows on MCP architecture, NLQ interfaces into building data, and AI\-accelerated prototyping are active investment areas — not backlog items.
   

  

 Third\-party building systems are not black boxes here. You will own the integration strategy for BMS, IoT, and CMMS platforms with the rigor of a first\-party product owner.
   

  

**What You Will Work On**
**Smart Building Platform strategy and roadmap**
 You will own the product roadmap for the Smart Building Platform, balancing near\-term delivery against long\-term strategic vision. That means translating client needs, market signals, and business objectives into a prioritized backlog — and defending those priorities with data. You will ensure the platform stays tightly aligned with JLL’s WPM delivery infrastructure and revenue goals, and evolve the roadmap as the IoT and AI landscape shifts underneath it.
   

  

**Building systems and IoT integration**
 Smart building products live or die on integration depth. You will define the integration strategy for building management systems (BMS/BAS), IoT sensor platforms, and CMMS systems — owning the specs that bridge protocols like BACnet and Modbus with JLL’s data layer. You will work closely with engineering to ensure the platform surfaces building system data in ways that are actionable, not just visible.
   

  

**AI and agentic product development**
 Workplace OS is JLL’s agentic platform, built on MCP architecture and natural language query capabilities. Your job is to define what Smart Building agents should do, and then build and ship them. That includes agents that reach into building systems to retrieve operational data, surface anomalies before they become incidents, and route work automatically based on real\-time conditions.
   

  

 This means building working AI prototypes — not just writing specs — to validate ideas quickly before engineering commitment. It means using AI tools (Claude, Copilot, and similar LLMs) as a daily productivity multiplier: synthesizing discovery findings, stress\-testing requirements. And it means knowing the difference between a demo and a workflow\-grade capability.
   

  

**Requirements, Specs, And Delivery**
 You will define high\-quality product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria — using AI tools with designers to accelerate drafting, iteration, and engineering handoff.
   

  

 Your requirements are not long drawn\-out documents but real working prototypes that you would have built along side your users. You will then work with engineering to bring those to production.
   

  

 You will partner with engineering and program managers through the full planning\-to\-release lifecycle, and define the success metrics that determine whether what shipped actually worked.
   

  

**Cross\-functional leadership**
 You will build and maintain strong working relationships with engineering, program management, operations, sales, and client success. You will represent the platform in executive reviews, client conversations, and external forums. You will navigate ambiguity confidently, making well\-reasoned decisions with incomplete information when the moment requires it.
   

  

**How You Will Spend Your Time**
 No two weeks look identical, but across a typical quarter you will be:
   

  

* Owning and prioritizing the Smart Building Platform roadmap, translating stakeholder input and discovery findings into a clear product direction that engineering can execute against
* Running discovery sessions with facilities teams, implementation leads, and enterprise clients to surface workflow pain and validate product direction
* Writing integration specs for BMS, IoT, and CMMS connections, with enough technical depth to lead the engineering conversation
* Building AI prototypes in collaboration with engineering — using LLM tooling and MCP integrations to validate use cases before committing to a full build
* Using AI tools fluently in your daily workflow: generating first drafts of PRDs, synthesizing research, producing competitive analyses, and accelerating design collaboration
* Defining KPIs and success metrics for every initiative, and communicating outcomes clearly to product leadership and client stakeholders
* Acting as the connective tissue between building operations teams, IoT/BMS engineering, and the data and AI platform organization

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Product Manager** 




 Bengaluru, India \| Full\-time 
 



  





***About us***




 RockED is a performance development platform built for the automotive industry. We partner with over 10,000 dealerships across the U.S., as well as major OEMs who use our platform to run and manage their own training programmes at scale. Our mobile\-first app helps dealerships onboard new hires faster, develop stronger teams, and reduce turnover by delivering bite\-sized training to sales reps, service advisors, and technicians right on their phones. 
 



 The platform spans learning and performance management. On the learning side, it includes an AI Coach for personalised practice, gamified learning, and role\-based certifications. On the performance management side, the platform surfaces real\-world performance data for dealership staff, such as service advisors, and recommends targeted training based on that data to drive measurable improvement on the floor. We are headquartered in Florida with our R\&D team in India, backed by investors with strong roots in automotive and EdTech. 
 



 We partner with 10000\+ dealerships, empower 60,000\+ learners, complete 15000\+ certifications, and have crossed 11 million lesson completions
 



  





**Check out our website https://www.rocked.us/** 




  





***Your Impact***




  





 This is one of the highest\-leverage seats on the product team. You'll sit close to Product leadership — not translating a roadmap someone else wrote, but owning real business problems end to end across learner experience, engagement, content delivery, and admin tools.
 



 You decide what "good" looks like for these areas, you build the case for what gets built next, and you're accountable for what happens after it ships.
 



 We're not looking for someone to run a backlog. We're looking for someone who can walk into a messy, half\-defined problem — service advisors aren't finishing training, managers ignore the admin dashboard — and turn it into a shipped answer without a lot of hand\-holding.
 



  





**What you will actually own?** 




  




* **The roadmap for learner experience, engagement, content delivery, and admin tools** 
 — not a list of features you're handed, but a point of view on what matters and why, one you can defend to leadership and to engineering.
* **Direct lines to the people who use this every day** 
 — dealership managers, sales reps, service advisors, technicians. You talk to them regularly, not once a quarter, because their world is the real spec.
* **PRDs and user stories, tight enough that engineers just run with them** 
 — no epic back\-and\-forth, no "wait, what did you mean by this." Clarity is the job.
* **A real seat at the design table** 
 — you should have opinions on the UX, and you should be comfortable telling design something feels off before it ships, not after.
* **The connective tissue with our US team** 
 — launches, timelines, stakeholder updates. Some overlap with US hours comes with this territory.
* **The metrics that prove, or disprove, your bets** 
 — you define what "working" means for your areas, and use it to decide what earns a place on the roadmap next.
* **Growth and engagement plays** 
 — using tools like MoEngage and HubSpot to get the right nudge to the right person at the right moment.



  





**How do we expect you to work?** 




  




* **Build, don't maintain.** 
 Most of what you'll own doesn't have a playbook yet — you'll be writing the first version of it
* **Speak fluent engineering.** 
 You don't need to write code, but you need to understand trade\-offs well enough that engineers don't have to over\-explain themselves to you, and well enough that they trust your calls
* **Use AI like it's already the default.** 
 We expect AI in the actual workflow — AI\-assisted discovery, AI for first\-draft docs and prioritisation, AI for turning raw customer feedback into patterns, AI for moving faster on the parts of the job that used to eat a whole afternoon
* **Own outcomes, not tasks.** 
 Nobody here grades you on how many tickets moved to "done." You're graded on whether the thing you shipped actually changed a number that mattered



  





**Who tends to thrive here?** 




  




* You like problems that are still messy — nobody's handing you a clean spec
* You think in systems, not features — you can see how a change to onboarding ripples into retention three months later
* You're obsessed with what the customer actually needs, not what's easiest to build
* You use data and judgment together — you can read a SQL query and still trust your gut when the data's incomplete
* You're curious enough to ask "why" more than once, and secure enough to challenge an assumption respectfully, even when it's someone senior's
* You know the difference between a feature that's interesting and one that moves the company
* You ship the 20% of a feature that carries 80% of the value — on purpose, not because you ran out of time
* EdTech or B2B SaaS background helps, but we care far more about how you think than the logo on your old business card.



  





**Why this, why now?** 




  





 We're growing over 100% year on year, backed by investors who've already built and exited multiple companies in this space. Our team spans the US and India, so you'll get exposure most Product Owners at this stage don't — to leadership, to investors, and to the real mechanics of scaling a platform used by frontline workers at 10,000\+ dealerships.
 



 We also run periodic in\-person workcations, because some of the best product thinking happens away from a desk.
 



**If owning a real slice of a fast\-scaling platform — with the freedom to build it your way and the accountability that comes with it — sounds like exactly the kind of company you want to build with, we want to talk to you.**

jobs.title: Sr Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About The Role**
 We are hiring a Sr. Data Product Manager to own a portfolio of Target Media data products end\-to\-end — from business definitions and contracts through datasets, pipelines, quality, governance, and delivery.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role that works closely with Data Engineering, Analytics and Media Partners. You will partner with DE day\-to\-day to build and evolve datasets and pipelines across a medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) architecture, shape schemas and contracts, and make sure the data products that result are trusted and well\-governed. The core job is to translate technical capability into business outcomes. You will sit at the intersection of Roundel product, Data Engineering, MediaOps, and the broader Media Data Consumers.
   

  

**What You’ll Own**
 We are looking for a Sr. Product Manager — Measurement \& Analytics to lead the strategy, development, and evolution of data products that enable marketing measurement and attribution across Target Media.
   

  

**Measurement – Must Have**
 This role sits at the intersection of Product, Marketing Measurement, Analytics and Data Engineering. You will own products that help the organization understand the impact of marketing investments across channels, campaigns, audiences, and customer journeys.
   

  

 The initial focus will be on Roundel and Target marketing spend, with the opportunity to expand measurement capabilities across loyalty, promotions, and other enterprise marketing investments.
   

  

 A core responsibility will be building and scaling attribution and measurement capabilities that connect marketing exposure and spend to business outcomes, enabling stakeholders to understand what worked, why it worked, and where to invest next.
   

  

 Analytics \& Data Fluency — Must Have
   

  

 Strong Working Knowledge Of Analytics And Data Concepts, With The Ability To Partner Effectively With Analytics Teams. You Should Be Comfortable With
   

  

* Customer\-level and aggregated analytics
* Data aggregation and dimensional modelling
* Data pipelines and data transformations
* Data quality and reconciliation
* Metric definitions and semantic layers


 Building data products with Data Engineering
   

  

 You work hand\-in\-hand with Data Engineering to turn requirements into real datasets and pipelines — translating business needs into clear specs, prioritizing the backlog, and making trade\-off calls with DE on design and sequencing.
   

  

 Platform \& ecosystem stewardship
   

  

 Solid understand of Data Platform, cloud environment of GCP/BQ/PowerBI
   

  

 Trust, governance \& data quality — critical
   

  

 Data governance and data quality are central to this role, not an afterthought. As operational systems and automated workflows act on Roundel data, the cost of a stale or wrong data product rises sharply.
   

  

**What You’ll Bring**
* 10\+ years in product management, with meaningful time across Measurement, data products, data platforms, AdTech/MarTech, or retail media.
* Proven understanding Marketing Measurement concepts of Attribution, MTA, MMM, etc.
* Hands\-on experience working closely with Data Engineering to build datasets and pipelines — writing specs, shaping schemas and contracts, and prioritizing a technical backlog.
* Solid understanding of medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) and modern data platforms (Lakehouse, data mesh, or federated architectures), including lineage and cost.
* Strong grasp of data governance and data quality — certification, monitoring, access, and consent — treated as critical, not optional.
* Track record of translating technical capability into measurable business outcomes and influencing cross\-functional partners without direct authority.
* Strong understand if PM Practices and working with Data Engineering, Analysts and Stakeholders.

jobs.title: Product Manager Performance - Star Trek Fleet Command
jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Product Manager to join the Star Trek™ Fleet Command team within our Midcore division in Bangalore, India on a hybrid basis.
   

  

 At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day—whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers developing, publishing, and innovating in the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.
   

  

**Star Trek™ Fleet Command** 
 is a top\-grossing MMO 4X strategy game that has captivated players for over five years. As we continue to expand and evolve the game, we are seeking a highly driven and analytical Senior Product Manager to own the performance and strategic direction of our live content, including monthly events, offers, and player experience.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 As the Product Manager – Performance, you’ll contribute to the optimization and execution of strategies that improve player engagement, retention, and monetization across our live game. You will focus on key LiveOps pillars such as events, feature performance, and live sales; ensuring that everything we launch is performant, data\-informed, and player\-first.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 You’ll play a key role in supporting high\-impact live systems by analyzing results, identifying improvement areas, and partnering with other stakeholders to adjust live operations in real time. Key responsibilities include:
   

  

* Monitor and evaluate the performance of recurring events, LiveOps features, and in\-game offers, identifying areas of improvement through player data and KPIs.
* Support the implementation and tuning of reward structures, pacing, and monetization strategies across multiple player segments.
* Help develop scalable, repeatable workflows for tracking LiveOps effectiveness and supporting in\-flight adjustments to maximize performance.
* Collaborate with Product Ops, Design, Economy, and Analytics to review event configurations and support the timely execution of LiveOps initiatives.


**What We’re Looking For**
* 2\-4 years of experience in product management, preferably with exposure to LiveOps in a free\-to\-play mobile game environment.
* Strong analytical mindset and experience working with product KPIs, dashboards, and A/B testing frameworks.
* Excellent communication and organization skills; able to coordinate effectively across teams including design, product marketing, economy, and data science.
* Attention to detail and a deep appreciation for the player experience.
* Passion for games, with an understanding of F2P systems, progression loops, and player behaviour.


**Work Schedule**
 This role follows a non\-standard working schedule to support close collaboration with a U.S.\-based team. The position requires a regular daily overlap from
 **9:30 PM to 11:30 PM IST** 
 to align with the Los Angeles team (this overlap is a fixed requirement). During the initial ramp\-up period, new hires are also expected to be available for collaboration during daytime hours, approximately between
 **10:30 AM and 4:30 PM IST** 
 , with some flexibility. Candidates should be comfortable working a split schedule during the ramp\-up phase, with at least
 **two hours of guaranteed overlap with the U.S. team** 
 .
   

  

 At Scopely, we create games for everyone \- and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us \& embrace the adventure!
   

  

**About Scopely**
 Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all\-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live\-operates one of the most diversified and award\-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.
   

  

 Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world\-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet\-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the \#1 mobile games company in the U.S. and \#2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. We're already trusted by millions in the US and we're quickly growing internationally — but how we do things here is a little different. You will own the end\-to\-end product life cycle for a data platform product that sits at the core of the bank's operations and regulatory obligations.

By their nature, our people are also solution\-oriented, commercially savvy and have a head for fintech. We work in tribes and squads that focus on specific products and projects. * Strong technical product management depth: fluency in software delivery, APIs/integrations, workflow patterns, and data concepts; able to write requirements engineers can build from.

**Position:** Senior QA Engineer – Manual / Automation Testing

**Job Type:** Manual / Automation Testing

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **Senior QA Engineer with 5\+ years of experience in Manual and/or Automation Testing**. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of software testing methodologies, test planning, defect management, API testing, and automation frameworks.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of web and software applications throughout the development lifecycle.

* Experience working in Agile product\-development environments.

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum **5\+ years of relevant QA/testing experience**.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a quality\-focused professional who can independently handle testing activities, identify critical issues before production, collaborate effectively with development teams, and contribute to improving both manual and automated QA processes.

Pay: Up to ₹80,000\.00 per month

As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Join us and build for travelers everywhere.


**Introduction to team:**
-------------------------

Data is central to how Expedia Group operates, serves travellers, and makes decisions. When data is incomplete, inaccurate, delayed, or difficult to interpret, the impact can extend across products, analytics, operations, and customer experiences.


The Data Quality Platform team is responsible for building a centralized, scalable, and extensible platform that helps teams proactively understand, validate, and trust their data across batch and streaming datasets. We provide automated profiling, configurable quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, incident workflows, alerting, and data health visibility so data producers can identify and resolve issues closer to the source.


We focus on building reliable, high\-performance, secure, and cost\-effective platform services that integrate with data pipelines and analytical systems. Typical technologies include Java, Kotlin, Spring, REST, gRPC, Amazon Web Services, Spark, Kafka, Airflow and Agentic AI. We encourage experimentation with new technologies, including machine\-assisted data quality workflows, while balancing short\- and long\-term goals and maintaining a high bar for platform quality and operational excellence.  



  

**In this role, you will:**
---------------------------

* Lead, coach, and develop one software engineering team responsible for designing, building, and operating robust, scalable, and secure Data Quality Platform services.
* Set technical direction for your team across data profiling, quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, alerting, incident management, and data health experiences.
* Lead and collaborate on complex, cross\-organizational initiatives, making thoughtful resource, delivery, product, and architectural trade\-offs to maximize strategic value.
* Partner closely with product managers, architects, program managers, data platform teams, and data domain owners to prioritize roadmaps, clarify requirements, and deliver measurable outcomes.
* Define and raise engineering standards for coding, testing, architecture, observability, security, continuous delivery, performance, and cost management.
* Ensure reliable operation of production systems through effective on\-call strategies, incident management, root\-cause analysis, capacity planning, and continuous improvement of service\-level indicators and objectives.
Safely integrate and operate machine\-assisted capabilities that improve rule authoring, anomaly detection, and issue explanation, applying artificial intelligence and machine learning concepts to practical data platform workflows.  
* 

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent Level; Technical Degree Preferred.
* 8\+ years of relevant professional experience and 3\+ years of people management experience.
* Proven track record of end\-to\-end ownership for complex software or data platform systems, including system design, application programming interface design, data modelling, implementation, and ongoing operations within a defined product or domain scope.
* Strong proficiency in core software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, testing, continuous integration and delivery, and building secure, reliable, and observable services.
* Experience working with data platforms, data quality, data observability, data pipelines, data contracts, analytics systems, or a closely related domain.
Demonstrated ability to set technical direction, make data\-driven trade\-offs, and align cross\-functional stakeholders to deliver high\-quality software at scale.  
* 

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**
-----------------------------

* Experience leading a software engineering team within a large\-scale, distributed technology environment, with accountability for team\-level architecture, technical strategy, and delivery outcomes.
* Track record of designing and evolving high\-throughput data systems, including service decomposition, data modelling at scale, backward\-compatible application programming interfaces, and integration with batch or streaming pipelines.
* Deep experience with production operations at scale, including site reliability engineering practices, capacity planning, performance optimization, and building systems for high availability and resilience.
* Demonstrated ability to drive architectural modernization, platform migration, or legacy system deprecation while maintaining strong delivery and operational outcomes.
* Experience with cloud\-native data processing, workflow orchestration, data contracts, anomaly detection, machine\-assisted software or data quality workflows, and observability platforms.
* Proven ability to build an inclusive, high\-performance engineering culture and develop engineers through feedback, coaching, career planning, and meaningful technical opportunities.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Have you ever wanted to be part of a team that builds highly efficient system for E\-reader?
  

Are you looking at creating value for millions of customers as we launch more E\-readers with additional capabilities? Do you want to work at a company where you are the owner, where you are encouraged to build, and where you have the autonomy to push boundaries? Do you have a passion for designing system that is an enabler for builders that create applications on top of it? This describes your daily journey. Are you ready? Then join us!  

  

Key job responsibilities  

As a Software Development Engineer, you will own adding capabilities as we unlock more features on Kindle E\-reader family. Our goal is to make it fast, easy and low\-cost for our internal application developers to build features and release them on our E\-reader stack.
  

You will tackle challenging, novel situations every day and given the size of this initiative, you’ll have the opportunity to work with multiple technical teams across Amazon.  

You should be comfortable with a level of depth that you need to dive into as we solve deep operating system level problems! We will need to tackle problems that span a variety of domains: software, hardware as well as automation.  

You design and develop the critical components in the operating system as well as low\-level components in E\-reader that make the product a performant, secure and power optimized device. You also write applications on top of our unique Kindle Operating system.
  

Along the way you’ll learn a ton, have fun and make a positive impact on millions of people.  

* You are proficient in C/C\+\+ to understand internals of E\-reader. If you know React Native, it will be a bonus as you can also write applications in E\-reader.
* Collaborate with experienced Amazonians to conceive, design, and bring innovative components in E\-reader
* Architect and design a secure software that protects customer data stored on the devices.

  

A day in the life  

In this role, you will be actively engaged in developing our system and writing applications that are based on C/C\+\+ and react native. You will also be a lead engineer guiding junior members in this role.  

  

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

jobs.description:
**Role Overview** 




 DrinkPrime runs a subscription business built on physical hardware. Our internal operations span finance, hardware production, inventory, procurement, warehousing, and field deployment. We are hiring a Senior Product Manager for Internal Business Systems to map how these workflows run today, design better ways of working, and convert them into clear system requirements that engineering can build against.
 



 This is an internal systems and process role, not a consumer product role. You do not need to be a finance or hardware expert, but you do need to be exceptional at process thinking, data discipline, stakeholder management, and execution.
 



**What You Will Do** 



* Map current\-state workflows across finance, hardware production, inventory, procurement, warehouse, and operations.
* Identify the gaps causing data mismatch, manual work, delays, duplication, and unclear ownership.
* Design improved workflows — including draft business rules, approval flows, and exception handling. Drive stakeholders toward a clear recommendation and decision
* Define source\-of\-truth logic for key business data: inventory, hardware units, vendors, invoices, production batches, stock movement, and deployment.
* Own the roadmap for internal business systems, and convert workflow design into clear, stable, well\-prioritised product requirements.
* Produce clear documentation like SOPs, process flows, and requirement specs, and monitor enforcement.
* Enable adoption of new workflows: training, rollout support, and tracking whether process and data quality are genuinely improving



  





**Requirements** 




**What We Require** 




 DrinkPrime is a Bengaluru\-based consumer technology company making clean drinking water more accessible through IoT\-enabled water purifiers offered on subscription. We serve over one lakh customers across Bengaluru, Delhi NCR, and Hyderabad.
 



 Our business combines consumer technology, connected hardware, field operations, supply chain, and subscription economics at scale. As we grow, we are investing in stronger internal systems and processes that give teams reliable data, clear ownership, and scalable ways of working.
 


* 4\+ years in product management, business systems, internal tools, business analysis, ERP or systems implementation, operations systems, or B2B workflow products.
* Hands\-on ownership of at least one internal business system end\-to\-end. You have implemented, migrated, or significantly extended a named system — ERP, WMS, inventory, procurement, invoicing, or equivalent. Having used such a system does not qualify.
* Direct experience with operational or physical\-goods workflows — production, inventory, warehouse, logistics, supply chain, or finance operations.



**What We Also Expect** 



* Strong process\-mapping and structured problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to convert ambiguous business problems into clear product requirements.
* Working fluency in data quality, source\-of\-truth design, exception handling, and reporting.
* Comfort operating with non\-technical stakeholders across finance, operations, production, warehouse, and procurement.
* Strong written communication and documentation discipline.
* The ability to push for clarity and constructively challenge weak process ownership.

Human data is the core infrastructure to AI advancement. Frontier AI labs currently improve model capabilities with various data\-intensive post\-training techniques. **About the Role****:**

We are looking for a Data Analyst to support the Finance and Central Operations organization and help build the data infrastructure, reporting, and analytics that power financial and operational decision\-making.

While reporting within the Finance team, this role will also partner closely with the Payment Operations team, helping improve the data, controls, and automation behind high\-volume payment processes.


This role requires close collaboration with our San Francisco–based team and availability during core U.S. business hours.

  

**Desired Capabilities:**

* 3–6\+ years of experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, data engineering, financial analytics, or a related field.
* Build and maintain scalable Finance and Operations dashboards and reporting across revenue, project expenses, margins, cash flows, payments, and other key financial and operational metrics.

* Establish documentation, data definitions, and controls that improve the reliability and auditability of Finance and Payments reporting.
* Experience with Python or another analytical programming language.

=========================

* Experience building dashboards and reporting using tools such as Hex, Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar.

==============

* Food credit for every in\-person day

**What role you will play in our team**

The ITSM Business Analyst supports the design, governance, adoption, and continuous improvement of IT Service Management (ITSM) processes, including Incident, Change, Problem, and Request Management. Working closely with ITSM Process Owners, Product Managers, Product Owners, Service Delivery teams, and ServiceNow platform teams, the role ensures that ITSM processes are well\-defined, effectively implemented, aligned with ITIL best practices, and continuously improved to meet business and operational objectives.


The position serves as a subject matter expert on ITSM processes and acts as a liaison between process stakeholders and platform teams, translating business requirements into actionable process and tooling requirements.

**What you will do**
--------------------

**Key Responsibilities**

**ITSM Process Analysis \& Governance**

* Support the governance and continuous improvement of ITSM processes, policies, standards, and procedures.
* Analyze and document current\-state and future\-state ITSM processes.
* Ensure alignment of processes with ITIL best practices and organizational standards.
* Identify process gaps, risks, and compliance issues and recommend corrective actions.
* Support process audits, governance reviews, and compliance assessments.

**Process Improvement**

* Perform process analysis to identify opportunities for efficiency, standardization, automation, and service quality improvements.
* Drive continuous service improvement initiatives using operational data, stakeholder feedback, and industry best practices.
* Analyze trends and recurring issues to recommend process enhancements.
* Maintain process documentation, workflows, and operating procedures.

**Requirements Management**

* Gather, analyze, document, and prioritize business and process requirements.
* Translate process requirements into functional requirements for ServiceNow and ITSM platform teams.
* Collaborate with Product Owners and technical teams to ensure process requirements are accurately implemented.
* Validate implemented solutions against business and process objectives.

**Performance Measurement \& Reporting**

* Define and maintain ITSM process KPIs, SLAs, compliance metrics, and performance measures.
* Develop reports, scorecards, and dashboards to monitor process effectiveness.
* Analyze and communicate process performance trends and provide recommendations for improvement.
* Support management reviews by preparing process performance presentations and reports.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Partner with IT product teams, service delivery teams, and management to gather feedback and improve process adoption.
* Facilitate process workshops, reviews, and stakeholder discussions.
* Communicate process updates, policy changes, and governance requirements to stakeholders.
